method: Each failing test identity was compared between a pristine origin/main checkout and the final branch code, run with the same command in the same environment.

known_baseline_failures.note: All 25 gNMI failures were reproduced individually on pristine main, not inferred from one.

clean_regression_final_state.set: 46 relevant test files excluding the six baseline files above
clean_regression_final_state.classification: environment-dependent, not a regression: the collector preflight passes only if a Splunk answers HEC health on 127.0.0.1:8088 or :8888. Earlier in the same session an unrelated local Splunk answered there (4,006 passed); at the final run nothing listened on either port, and the identical preflight fails on a pristine main checkout in the same environment.
clean_regression_final_state.demo_check: The NetSpout demo Splunk (HEC on its own port 18088) was healthy throughout; the ports probed by this test belong to no NetSpout component.
